name: Pagination
purpose: Represent movement through ordered result pages with named navigation, current-page state, and link or controlled activation semantics.
useWhen: A collection or result set is divided into ordered pages.

avoidWhen.condition: The relationship is page ancestry, local panels, or sequential article navigation.

composition: Compose Root and List with Page items plus Previous, Next, and Ellipsis as needed.
For URL-backed results, provide Root getPageHref so Item, Previous, and Next render native anchors; derive controlled Root page from the current route.

rules.statement: Expose exactly one current page and keep page labels meaningful to assistive technology.
Use Root getPageHref when pages have URLs so native navigation, sharing, reload, and modified-click behavior continue to work.
In link mode, let the browser or router own navigation; do not depend on onPageChange or replace native anchor behavior with button activation.

commonMistakes.mistake: Rendering URL-backed pages as buttons or composing an anchor while Root remains in button mode.
commonMistakes.correction: Provide Root getPageHref; optionally enhance its generated anchors through onClick without breaking modified clicks.

commonMistakes.mistake: Rendering disabled previous or next controls as active links, or using pagination for ancestry.
commonMistakes.correction: Boundary controls must expose disabled semantics without an href; use Breadcrumb for hierarchy.

validation: Confirm current, first, last, previous, next, disabled, and ellipsis states.
Confirm each control has a unique accessible name and URL-backed pages expose real destinations.
In link mode, verify reload, copy/share URL, Back/Forward, Cmd/Ctrl-click, and disabled boundary controls without href.
